assets.asset: Fox X Supreme Helmet (a Fox V1-style motocross helmet)
assets.author: Muhammad Seno Aji (senoaji)
assets.changes: OBJ imported in Blender; goggles removed (lens, frame, foam, clips and strap); the liner and the vent meshes re-materialed as plain dark materials; the Supreme shell texture replaced by a 2048 px projection bake of five Fox Racing V1 Sayak (2018, matte red) product photos (Motocard), each projected through an orthographic camera fitted to the helmet's silhouette, with occlusion, facing and edge weights, studio highlights clamped and unseen texels filled red or black; the Fox marks in the photos are kept by the owner's choice; satin, non-metallic paint; centred, chin forward and scaled to 0.30 m; optimized with glTF-Transform (meshopt, 2048 px WebP) by scripts/prepare-display-offroad-fox.mjs and scripts/prepare-display-offroad-fox.py. It stands for the owner's own helmet model; the mesh is senoaji's, not Fox's V1 shell, so it is not the owner's exact helmet. Fox, V1 and Sayak belong to Fox Racing; no affiliation.

graphicReference.note: Five third-party product photos of the Fox V1 Sayak (2018, matte red) from Motocard (left three-quarter, front, right side, back and top; sha256 pinned in scripts/prepare-display-offroad-fox.mjs). Their pixels are baked into the texture of the shipped GLB; the photos themselves are not shipped, and they are not covered by this license, which applies to senoaji's mesh. Fox, V1 and the Fox marks belong to Fox Racing; no affiliation.

assets.asset: Buffalo Bills Helmet (a Riddell SpeedFlex recreation)
assets.author: Exodusks
assets.changes: Bills decals removed; shell repainted with a gold and black Rams-style horn livery (a wide black horn a side, pointed at the forehead, around the ear hole) and a small block #32 low on the back, projected in a new (azimuth, elevation) UV atlas; facemask, bumpers, clips and chin strap painted black; a smoked black eye shield added between the cage's top bars; interior padding decimated; parts merged into shell, facemask, padding, trim, hardware and eye-shield, centred, turned facemask-forward and scaled to 0.30 m; optimized with glTF-Transform (meshopt, 2048 px WebP) by scripts/prepare-display-football.mjs and scripts/prepare-display-football.py. Not the owner's exact helmet; no NFL or team logo is shipped.

graphicReference.note: Photo of a Los Angeles Rams helmet used only as a visual reference for the horn's path; the photo is not shipped and is not covered by this license. Riddell, SpeedFlex, the Rams and the Bills belong to their owners; no affiliation.

assets.asset: Blossom Katana (a tabletop stand with two katanas and a scabbard)
assets.author: Mitchell Bekke
assets.changes: Shipped as authored (geometry, materials and textures unchanged; no simplification): meshes sharing a material joined, geometry meshopt-compressed and the nine 1024 px textures re-encoded as WebP with glTF-Transform by scripts/prepare-wall-katana.mjs; turned to face the room and scaled to 1.2 m at runtime.

original.author: Kevnnard
